adelaide-hills-9.name: Hahndorf Academy
adelaide-hills-9.bio: Gallery and museum on Main Street with German settler and Peramangk history and Heysen drawings.

notes.cost: Museum and gallery free per draft; site lists a shop and paid workshops only (not confirmed free on the site itself).

adelaide-hills-10.name: Hahndorf Farm Barn
adelaide-hills-10.bio: Farm animal park at Hahndorf where visitors feed lambs, milk cows and watch daily shows.

notes.pin: Wikivoyage geotag; site address Hahndorf, check in serial pass.
notes.cost: Site shows "From $15.50 child admission" only; adult price not found (older listings $15-17.50 adult). 15.5 is a floor, verify adult.
notes.status: Operating: official site open daily 10am-4pm, shows 11am and 2:30pm. Earlier sale report not borne out.

adelaide-hills-11.name: Stirling
adelaide-hills-11.bio: Hills village of laneways, shops and cafes, with a laneways market on the fourth Sunday of most months.

notes.pin: place=village centre, Mt Barker Rd/Druids Ave; no coordinate in draft.

adelaide-hills-12.name: The Big Rocking Horse
adelaide-hills-12.bio: An 18 m rocking horse at Gumeracha that visitors can climb, beside an animal park and minigolf.

notes.cost: Climb $2; animal park entry $7 (site). Looking at the horse and shop is free.

adelaide-hills-13.name: National Motor Museum
adelaide-hills-13.bio: Birdwood museum of cars and motorcycles from all eras, with the Bay to Birdwood festival finish held here.

notes.cost: Adult $22.50 per search snippet of the museum site and tourism listings; fetch of the page failed, verify.

adelaide-hills-14.name: Gorge Wildlife Park
adelaide-hills-14.bio: Cudlee Creek wildlife park where visitors walk among kangaroos and can cuddle a koala at set times.

notes.cost: Adult $26, concession $23, child $15 (site). Koala cuddles extra.
notes.pin: Cudlee Creek Rd; draft pin to 8 decimals from tourism listing.

adelaide-hills-15.name: Mount Barker Summit
adelaide-hills-15.bio: A 513 m summit reached by a 500 m walk from the car park, with Peramangk interpretive signs and wide views.

notes.pin: Mount Barker Summit Reserve car park, Bald Hills exit; summit is a natpeak in OSM; reserve gates 8am-6pm (to 8pm in summer).

adelaide-hills-15.ticket_note: Council/reserve page not confirmed; tourism listing is not official.

adelaide-hills-16.name: Kuitpo Forest
adelaide-hills-16.bio: Forest near Meadows with walking trails of 1 to 4 hours, mountain-bike tracks and camping.

notes.pin: Information centre / Rocky Creek Hut or Chookarloo campground; trailheads: Eucalypts at Rocky Creek Hut (Razorback Rd), Chookarloo Walk at Chookarloo Campground.
notes.cost: Walking, hiking, cycling and picnicking free per ForestrySA 2024 fee schedule; vehicle access permit ($29/vehicle/day, May-Oct) may apply, unverified for Kuitpo.
notes.closures: Some areas close for forestry operations.

adelaide-hills-17.name: Mount Bold Reservoir Reserve
adelaide-hills-17.bio: SA Water reserve with 13 km of trails, including a short lookout walk to a viewing platform.
adelaide-hills-17.ticket_note: SA Water page blocked by bot wall.

notes.pin: Reserve car park / lookout trail start at the dam wall; lookout trail 1.4 km return.

adelaide-hills-18.name: Lobethal Bushland Park
adelaide-hills-18.bio: Two reservoirs in stringybark forest north of Lobethal, with walking circuits and a regenerating post-fire landscape.
adelaide-hills-18.ticket_note: Run by Adelaide Hills Council; council page not verified.

notes.pin: Trailhead car park near the building and picnic area, north of Lobethal.

adelaide-hills-19.name: Yurrebilla Trail
adelaide-hills-19.bio: A 54 km trail from Belair to Ambers Gully through Hills parks, walked in sections or over several days.
adelaide-hills-19.ticket_note: yurrebilla.com.au and parks.sa.gov.au pages returned no readable title or content; not verified.

notes.name_fix: Draft said Chain of Ponds and 56 km; sources give the southern end at Belair railway station and the northern end at the River Torrens at Ambers Gully, 54 km (56 km is a race listing).
notes.pin: Midpoint of the route (OSM route=hiking relation); long trail, centre of whole length.
notes.hours: visit range is hours for a whole walk; confirm field convention in the pin/apply pass.

adelaide-hills-20.name: Gumeracha
adelaide-hills-20.bio: Small Torrens Valley town in the Adelaide Hills, about 40 minutes from Adelaide.

notes.pin: place=town centre (draft coordinate may be it).
notes.flag: Thin as a spot: draws are the Big Rocking Horse and nearby sights, which are spots of their own; consider merging or dropping.
